authorization: user explicitly authorized adaptive acceleration and requested approximately 98 percent five-hour-window utilization without cutting off in-progress agents
scope: semantic leaf waves created after owner-merge-batch-0001

adaptive_pacing.keep_or_raise_when: launches are complete, fewer than 10 percent of leaves have capacity failures, and useful backlog remains
adaptive_pacing.raise_sequence: the completed 32-leaf cross-shard discovery wave satisfies the first stage; launch the next independently gated semantic wave at 40, then use 48 after a clean complete 40-leaf transaction while useful backlog remains
adaptive_pacing.downshift_to_24_when: a 32-leaf wave has at least 10 percent capacity failures or cannot establish its complete immutable receipt set
adaptive_pacing.recovery_rule: preserve every completed output and retry only invalid or unlaunched assignments with fresh identities
adaptive_pacing.usage_goal: temporarily target approximately 98 percent usage immediately before the current reset, leaving a two-percent safety margin for in-progress completion; every unit of usage must advance an audit artifact

post_reset_policy.steady_state_goal: useful sustainable throughput with clean immutable completions, not the temporary pre-reset burn rate

monitoring.pipeline_rule: prepare and independently validate the next immutable batch while the current semantic wave runs when namespaces do not overlap
monitoring.active_reviewer_rule: do not overlap reviewers that write or validate the same immutable transaction; pipeline only disjoint preparation or validation, and launch the next semantic wave immediately after its required gate is durable
